teaser: Following the U.S. decision to impose a 50 per cent tariff on $27.6 billion of Canadian goods effective August 22, Minister Champagne confirmed today that Canada will match the new U.S. tariffs dollar for dollar, rate for rate, with additional Canadian tariffs on U.S. goods.
title: Canada announces targeted countermeasures and substantive support for workers and businesses in response to U.S. tariffs
